title: snapshot.snapshot_concussion payload
description: M4 § M9 firehose surface (deep damage). Placeholder payload at M4 (placeholder=true); M9 fills by_actor with concussion / internal-shock / g-load doses. Fires at scenario start and on every objective transition.

placeholder.description: True when emitted by M4 with a stub payload; M9 producer fills real data and clears this flag.

by_actor.description: Per-actor concussion state: { actor_id, origin_id, concussion_dose, band: Clear|Mild|Moderate|Severe|KO_Imminent|KO, recovery_rate_per_s, internal_shock_dose (robots only), g_load_dose (humans + androids only) }.
